next_steps: Pick the one event that matters (for example a sign-up or a lead) and set an ad set to optimise for it, with a target cost per result.

Meta wants about 50 results in 7 days to leave learning. At USD 1.00 a day, that needs a cost per result of USD 0.14 or less (7 days x 1.00 / 50), which only cheap events like post engagement reach. Fund one ad set to target x 50 / 7 a day, or optimise for an earlier event first.
Switch an ad set on in Ads Manager (the API can't), then run this skill again after at least 7 days of delivery, and after 28 days for the full report.
